replacements.Tres etapas con requisitos de datos dist: Three stages with different data requirements. Failures at each stage propagate to the next: noisy data at the foundation produces fragile representations that fine-tuning cannot repair.
replacements.sim(v<sub>I</sub>, v<sub>T</sub>) ↑ — ac: sim(v<sub>I</sub>, v<sub>T</sub>) ↑ — bring closer in the space
replacements.sim(v<sub>I</sub>, v<sub>T'</sub>) ↓ — a: sim(v<sub>I</sub>, v<sub>T'</sub>) ↓ — push farther apart in the space
replacements.1.800M pares — alta escala, baja precisi: 1.8B pairs — high scale, low precision per pair
replacements.Categorías frecuentes aprenden represent: Frequent categories learn strong representations. "dog", "city", and "food" appear millions of times in different combinations.
replacements.Pares ruidosos (pie de foto irrelevante,: Noisy pairs (irrelevant caption, contextual image) and infrequent categories produce fragile representations that fine-tuning cannot repair.
replacements.Datos ruidosos aquí → representaciones f: Noisy data here → fragile representations → fine-tuning works on a weak foundation
replacements.Evaluadores humanos crean o validan inst: Human evaluators create or validate the instruction + response for each image. Gold standard, but it does not scale.
replacements.LLaVA usó GPT-4 para generar los datos d: LLaVA used GPT-4 to generate visual-instruction data. Fast, but the generator model's blind spots are reproduced in the dataset.
replacements.Puntos ciegos heredados aquí → el RLHF s: Blind spots inherited here → RLHF can only polish style, not repair underlying errors
replacements.Ajustar formato, longitud y tono de resp: Adjust response format, length, and tone
replacements.Reducir respuestas evasivas o innecesari: Reduce evasive or unnecessarily long responses
replacements.Capturar preferencias que el entrenamien: Capture preferences that supervised training does not model
replacements.Eliminar puntos ciegos del dataset sinté: Remove blind spots inherited from the synthetic dataset
replacements.Evitar que los sesgos del evaluador se c: Prevent evaluator biases from becoming encoded in the model
replacements.La calidad de los datos manda sobre la a: Data quality dominates architecture. A model with clean data and a simple architecture is more robust than one with an advanced architecture and noisy data.
